evidence.detail: make_final_list() calls canonical_legal_name() which calls oracle.canonical_name_or_self(); for flip cards this resolves to the front face name only (e.g. 'Erayo, Soratami Ascendant'), so legal_cards.txt never includes 'Erayo's Essence'
canonical_name() for flip layout returns faces[0]['name'] (front face), confirming only the front is stored as the card's canonical name
PDBot (the modo bot) is closed-source and not in this repo; the exact legality check it performs against legal_cards.txt cannot be confirmed from this codebase alone

triage.notes: The plausible fix in this repo would be to expand make_final_list() in rotation_script/rotation_script.py to also write the back-face name of any flip-layout legal card to legal_cards.txt. But confirming this is where PDBot performs its check requires access to the PDBot codebase.
